title: [GMCP 203.028.06] Operations and evidence: Secrets, credentials, and cryptographic lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-028-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: MCP credentials and private keys live in OS-backed secret storage or an explicit encrypted fallback, are referenced rather than copied into configs, and follow creation, least-scope, rotation, revocation, export prohibition and secure deletion policies. Secret scanning, redaction canaries and crash/core-dump tests prove secrets do not enter arguments, logs, traces, task files, environment inheritance or diagnostics. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
